anatomy.demo: ProductDesireFactsBuy

parts.desc: 清楚展示外观、质地、比例和关键细节
parts.desc_en: Clear views of form, texture, scale, and important details

parts.desc: 摄影与排版建立使用场景和情绪期待
parts.desc_en: Photography and typography that create a believable use context

parts.desc: 价格、规格、评价、配送和退换信息完整可见
parts.desc_en: Complete price, option, review, delivery, and return information

parts.desc: 选择规格和加入购物袋的路径直接、稳定、可返回
parts.desc_en: A direct, stable path from choosing an option to adding the item

use.t: 美妆、服饰、食品和生活方式品牌：商品本身有较强视觉与故事
品牌直接面对消费者：官网同时承担表达和销售
需要解释材质、工艺或使用方法：内容能降低选择成本
复购和组合购买重要：推荐、套装和会员信息能自然融入路径

dont.t: 先弹优惠再让人看商品：连续弹窗会打断判断，也削弱品牌感
图片突出但缺少关键信息：价格、规格和配送说明不易获取
商品只使用泛化促销词：缺少差异信息，难以帮助用户选择
移动端购买入口距离决策信息过远：长内容中仍应让关键行动容易返回

principles.t: 让商品信息先被看见：摄影、排版和装饰都要帮助用户理解产品与使用感受
购买信息靠近行动：价格、规格、库存、配送和退换不要藏在远处
品牌故事服务选择：成分、工艺和理念要回答为什么值得买
评价要具体可信：展示数量、来源和真实使用语境，不只放五颗星

entry.prompt: 做一个护肤品牌的商品详情页。先让用户看清产品、适用场景和成分，再把规格、价格、已授权评价、配送说明和加入购物车放在决策位置附近；画面有品牌感，但购买信息不要被装饰淹没。只使用我提供的商品与评价资料，缺少的价格、功效依据、评分或政策先标为“待补充”，不要编造。
entry.prompt_en: DTC e-commerce product page, high-quality product and lifestyle photography, editorial typography, warm off-white canvas with a restrained brand color, price, options, reviews, delivery and add-to-bag action placed together, balancing brand expression with shopping efficiency

references.title: 电商 UX 趋势：用户研究更新
references.title_en: Ecommerce UX Trends: User Research Update

en.prompt: DTC e-commerce product page, high-quality product and lifestyle photography, editorial typography, warm off-white canvas with a restrained brand color, price, options, reviews, delivery and add-to-bag action placed together, balancing brand expression with shopping efficiency

use.t: Beauty, fashion, food, and lifestyle brands with visually distinctive products and stories
Brands selling directly to customers, where the website must express identity and convert
Products that benefit from material, process, or usage guidance to reduce uncertainty
Businesses driven by repeat and bundle purchases, where recommendations and sets belong naturally in the journey

dont.t: Interrupt with offers before showing the product; repeated popups damage judgment and brand confidence
Use beautiful images without buying facts, leaving price, options, and delivery hard to find
Label every item a must-have bestseller; without difference, the language cannot help anyone choose
Place the mobile purchase action far away; it should remain easy to reach through longer content

principles.t: Keep the product in the lead: photography, type, and decoration should help people understand the item and experience
Keep buying facts close to the action: price, option, availability, delivery, and returns should not be hidden
Use the brand story to support choice: material, process, and point of view should explain why the product is worth buying
Make reviews specific and credible: show volume, source, and real use context rather than five stars alone
